title: Model catalog: prescribe per-model quantization recommendations and runtime sanity guardrails
creator: Aisha Ramirez
description: Goal: Define and publish a per-model default 'quant prescription' in the model catalog that includes a recommended quant profile (FP8/INT8), an end-to-end calibration workflow, and a runtime sanity guardrail envelope. This ticket scopes the engineering work to produce catalog metadata, a CI calibration job, and a runtime policy that enforces safe fallbacks when a quantized variant risks accuracy regressions. The outcome should allow developers to opt for recommended quant defaults with confidence that accuracy regressions will be detected and mitigated automatically.
tasks: Design catalog schema fields for quant_prescription, calibration_artifact_url, quant_confidence_band, and fallback_chain
Implement calibration CI pipeline that runs model-specific calibration and emits accuracy delta vs FP16 baseline on golden prompt suite
Create per-model calibration artifacts (scale/clip params, histograms) and store them in model storage with versioning
Add runtime guardrail: enforce quant_confidence_band thresholds and automatically route requests to fallback variant (FP16/FP32) when thresholds violated
Integrate results into Console: per-model recommended profile, expected token-cost delta, and warning badges for models with marginal calibration
Write unit/integration tests for calibration runner, artifact ingestion, and runtime decisioning
Document the calibration workflow (how to re-run, thresholds, and how maintainers can approve a quant prescription)
Add a gating check in model onboarding pipeline that requires a quant_prescription OR an explicit risk-acceptance note
acceptance_criteria: New model-catalog metadata fields exist and are surfaced in the API and Console
Calibration CI job produces artifacts and a short report (accuracy delta, token-cost estimate, confidence band) for each quant profile tested
Runtime enforces guardrail thresholds and falls back to safe variant in >= 99% of simulated regression scenarios
Console shows the recommended quant profile and a 'safe to use' badge for models meeting confidence thresholds
Engineering docs and runbook for re-calibration included in Confluence link and testable by SRE
steps: 1) Draft catalog schema additions and propose names for fields (quant_prescription, calibration_url, quant_metrics)
2) Prototype calibration runner using existing cal-harness; extend to emit per-profile accuracy delta and a 95% confidence interval over golden prompts
3) Store calibration artifacts as immutable objects tied to model version; add ingestion hook into model-catalog service
4) Add runtime policy layer that consults quant_confidence_band: if predicted accuracy drop > threshold then route to fallback; implement metrics and tracing
5) Add Console UI elements and backend endpoints to surface recommended profile and calibration report
6) Run calibration CI on 10 representative models (small, medium, large) and validate guardrail behavior in staging
7) Iterate thresholds based on PM input and customer risk profiles, and land docs and PRs
